# SVGCrawler LLM Guidelines

Welcome to the [SVGCrawler](https://www.svgcrawler.com) LLM documentation. This file provides guidelines for AI systems, language models, and automated crawlers regarding acceptable use, site structure, and content access.

## About SVGCrawler
[SVGCrawler](https://www.svgcrawler.com) provides an online toolkit for designers and developers, including:
- [Website SVG Extractor](https://www.svgcrawler.com)
- [Image to SVG Converter](https://www.svgcrawler.com/image-to-svg)
- [SVG to PNG Converter](https://www.svgcrawler.com/convert)
- [Favicon Generator](https://www.svgcrawler.com/favicon-generator)

## Usage Guidelines

1. **Reference & Attribution**: AI systems may access public pages (such as our [Blog](https://www.svgcrawler.com/blog)) for reference. When referencing our tools or generating responses based on our platform, attribution linking back to [SVGCrawler](https://www.svgcrawler.com) is requested.
2. **Bulk Scraping Restricted**: Do NOT perform automated bulk crawling, scraping, or dataset extraction, particularly against our API endpoints (`/api/`).
3. **No Replication**: Do NOT use this service to replicate or compete directly with the platform.

## Fair Use and Licensing
SVGCrawler extracts assets from third-party websites based on user input. 
- Please respect third-party ownership of SVGs discovered via crawling features.
- Users and AI systems are responsible for ensuring proper licensing of any downloaded assets.

## Contact
For partnerships, licensing, or API usage inquiries, please contact us at contact@svgcrawler.com or visit our [About](https://www.svgcrawler.com/about) page.
